procedure.solvent: anhydrous chloroform: 600 mL initial plus 200 mL in the acryloyl chloride solution
procedure.addition: acryloyl chloride solution added dropwise at 0 C
procedure.workup: Remove chloroform; add 800 mL hexane; filter precipitate; wash filtrate with water 150 mL three times; dry organic material using sodium sulfate; concentrate.
procedure.purification: distillation under reduced pressure; colourless oil
procedure.product_specific_characterization: Figures S1-S2 include labelled AEMA structure and assigned monomer 1H NMR control containing BHT; no independent purity estimate is inferred.
procedure.storage: add 1 mol% BHT and store at -20 C
